items.question: Is the online safety report free?
items.answer: Yes. You can start with the online safety report at no cost. A professional in-home assessment visit costs {{visitFee}} and is credited toward your CasaMia plan if you proceed with approved improvements.

items.question: Do I have to install anything after the assessment?
items.answer: No. The assessment gives you clarity first. CasaMia explains what looks urgent, what can wait, and what would need a proposal before any work is booked.

items.question: What does CasaMia manage if we continue?
items.answer: CasaMia can coordinate the route end to end: scope, proposal, compatible products, vetted installers, grant-document preparation where relevant, scheduling, safe-use explanation and follow-up.

items.question: Can we use photos, videos or a phone call before a visit?
items.answer: Yes. You can start online with guided answers, photos, short videos, voice notes or a call. If measurement or professional review is needed, you see the visit details before booking.

items.question: Can CasaMia help with public grants?
items.answer: CasaMia checks possible grant routes and prepares supporting documents when the route fits the work. The public authority decides eligibility, approval, amount and timing.

faq.title: Questions people ask before choosing a plan.

items.question: Which plan should I choose?
items.answer: If you are unsure, start with the free online safety report. If you need a professional visit, CasaMia will confirm the in-home assessment fee before booking.

items.question: Is the online safety report really free?
items.answer: Yes. The online photo-based safety report is free. A professional in-home assessment visit costs {{visitFee}}, credited toward your CasaMia plan if you proceed.

items.question: Do I have to proceed with installation after the assessment?
items.answer: No. You receive recommendations first, then decide what fits the home, the person using it and any approved contacts.

items.question: Are installers insured?
items.answer: CasaMia works with trusted installation partners and structures projects around insured professional work.

items.question: When do I pay?
items.answer: The {{visitFee}} assessment fee includes {{visitVatPercent}} VAT and is paid in advance at booking. Installation plans use a clear {{proposalUpfrontPercent}} deposit and {{proposalBalancePercent}} final payment after completion and customer acceptance.

items.question: Can the plan be customized?
items.answer: Yes. The final scope is matched to the home, the person using it, and the safety priorities found during assessment.

items.question: Do you support smart safety devices?
items.answer: Yes. The Smart Safety Plan can include sensors, emergency response devices, smart lighting, access devices and setup support when they fit the home and consent is clear.

items.question: What happens after the work is completed?
items.answer: We complete a handover, confirm the customer accepts the work, and explain who to contact if the home or routine changes later.

faqs.question: Can I control everything from my phone?
faqs.answer: Many devices can be controlled from a phone when compatible, but CasaMia limits the setup to controls the person can reliably use.

faqs.question: Do smart devices require Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Most smart devices require reliable Wi-Fi or connectivity. We review this during the assessment before recommending devices.

faqs.question: Will you train me to use the system?
faqs.answer: Yes. Training and handover are part of the Smart Safety Plan.

faqs.question: Can additional devices be added later?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system can usually be expanded later as needs change, subject to compatibility.

page.title: Before & After
page.body: Explore upgrades that reduce everyday movement, transfer, entrance and night-time risks at home.
page.galleryTitle: From everyday risk to safer daily routines
page.galleryBody: Each transformation shows the risk CasaMia looks for and the improvement that can be scoped after a home safety assessment.

beforeAfter.disclaimer: Images are for illustration purposes. Every home is assessed individually and recommended improvements may vary.

transformations.title: Bathroom Safety Upgrade
transformations.before: Wet-floor transfers with little support around the shower or toilet.
transformations.after: Clear support points, anti-slip surfaces, and safer daily bathroom movement.
benefits: Grab bars where support is needed

transformations.title: Safer Stairs
transformations.before: Steps that feel uncertain because support, contrast, or lighting is limited.
transformations.after: Continuous handrails, visible step edges, and safer movement between floors.

transformations.title: Easy & Safe Entry
transformations.before: Raised thresholds, narrow entry points, or poor lighting at arrival.
transformations.after: A smoother, better-lit entrance with support where balance is needed.
benefits: Support points for arrival and exit

transformations.title: Kitchen Safety Upgrade
transformations.before: Busy kitchen routines can mean awkward reach, slippery zones, hot surfaces or cluttered movement routes.
transformations.after: Clearer work zones, safer reach, anti-slip flooring, lighting and appliance safeguards.

transformations.title: Bedroom Safety Upgrade
transformations.before: Getting in and out of bed can be harder when lighting, support or floor space is limited.
transformations.after: Better bedside lighting, clear routes, stable support and lower-risk night movement.

transformations.title: Living Area Safety
transformations.before: Chairs, rugs, cables and tight routes can make everyday sitting and movement less secure.
transformations.after: Clear walking routes, safer seating height and support near daily-use areas.
benefits: Reduced rug and cable trip risks
